# MentivisOS

## Overview
MentivisOS is an AI-native pedagogical engine — not an LMS, not a catalog. It's a training operating system that designs, deploys, and operates end-to-end training programs with generative AI integrated structurally into the learning pipeline.

## Stack
- Next.js 16.2.6, TypeScript, Webpack-only
- sql.js (WASM SQLite) for data persistence
- Bilingual FR/EN, default FR
- Hosted on o2switch shared hosting, Passenger, Node 20.20.2
- JWT + role-based authentication

## Architecture
- NavBar → MegaMenu, MobileAccordionNav
- PageHero (CMS-driven) → shared hero component for all product/info pages
- CmsPageHero → fetches hero content from CMS API with fallback to defaults
- Product pages: Hero → FeatureGrid → WorkflowTabs → Showcase → Pipeline → Enterprise → Testimonials → FAQ → CTABlock
- Data via sql.js SQLite at /home/sc4bovu7233/data/ (persistent, auto-backup on deploy)

## Key Pages
- / → Homepage with HeroUnit, ProblemSection, SectorShowcase, TransformationTimeline, FAQ
- /learningos → AI-native training system product page
- /talentos → AI recruitment system product page
- /about → Company/about page
- /security → Security and compliance page
- /ambassadors → Affiliation & Ambassadors program
- /impact → Impact program (ICIA x MentivisOS)
- /blog → News & publications (CMS-managed)
- /tarifs → Pricing page
- /carrieres → Careers/jobs page
- /contact → Contact form
- /demo → Demo request page

## CMS
- Content management at /content-management (god role required)
- Pages: hero content editable per page (homepage, learningos, talentos, about, security, ambassadors)
- Posts: blog articles with categories
- SEO: JSON-LD structured data
- Jobs: career listings
- Pricing: plan configuration

## Deploy
- ./scripts/deploy-unlock.sh (auto-unlocks SSH, pushes to GitHub, deploys)
- Zero-downtime atomic swap with health check and auto-rollback
- Build: npm run build --webpack (NEVER use Turbopack)
- Public assets must be git-tracked (deploy does git reset --hard)

## Conventions
- Components: PascalCase, files: kebab-case (assets) / PascalCase (components)
- CSS vars: --color-*, --text-*, --font-*, --grid-*
- camelCase variables/functions
- Inter font only, no serif
- Dark mode only, WCAG AA
- No utility CSS frameworks, no Tailwind
- No em dashes (—) in prose text
- Tone: factual, precise. Forbidden: innovation, disruption, révolutionnaire, solution, écosystème
